newsitem.title: USA: American Greetings may sell non-core units - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: American Greetings may sell non-core units - WSJ.

text.p: American Greetings Corp may sell some of its businesses that are outside of its core greeting card operations, The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.
The company has tried to diversify its greeting card business with other consumer products in recent years, but may change strategies, the story said.
Along with greeting cards, the company makes and sells hair accessories, picture frames, gift wrapping and eye glasses, the story said.

"We need to re-evaluate whether that's the hand we want to stay with," company Chief Executive Morry Weiss is quoted as saying, though he declined to say which businesses the company is considering selling.
